title: External therapy operator (schema v1.0)
description: One external intervention described as a parametric operator: what, where, how, how much, how often. The model deliberately has NO default mapping from these parameters to the six state axes - supplying that mapping is the contribution, and it is a claim that needs a source.

points.description: WHO standard point codes (LI4, ST36, SP6...). Empty is acceptable for region-based manual therapy.

region.description: For manual therapy: e.g. 足太阳膀胱经 first line, 腹部, 肩井区

technique.description: e.g. tonifying (补), reducing (泻), even (平补平泻), 一指禅推法, 滚法, 点按

intensity.description: as reported: mA for EA, or a qualitative level (得气, 酸胀, 轻度)

target_axes.description: Optional: which state axes this operator is claimed to move, and in which direction. This is the mapping the model needs.

gain.description: relative strength, 0-3; state if this is an estimate

calibrated.description: false = hand-picked, true = fitted/measured with data attached
